title: Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Addendum Basis Price Where Factory Complimentary Maintenance Is in Force
content:
# Basis Price of a Fleet Addendum and Factory Complimentary Maintenance

Plan visits of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans are not used while factory complimentary maintenance pays. The basis price of a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum therefore follows the factory maintenance coverage of the unit being enrolled. That unit is the one delivered on the customer's single Kessler Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement standing in delivered status, as the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records show. Its coverage is read from its Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage records. The pricing date is the day the addendum is signed.

## Rule
| The unit being enrolled has | Basis price |
|---|---|
| An active Factory Complimentary Maintenance coverage **with a mileage limit** | The plan's retail plan price times the **greater** of the months share and the miles share |
| An active Factory Complimentary Maintenance coverage **with no mileage limit** (expiration odometer recorded as 0) | The plan's retail plan price times the months share |
| No active Factory Complimentary Maintenance coverage | The plan's retail plan price |

**Definitions:**
- **Months share** is the plan's term months left after the coverage ends, over the plan's term months. The months left are the term months less the whole months from the pricing date to the coverage's expiration date, never below 0.
- **Miles share** is the plan's term miles left after the coverage ends, over the plan's term miles. The miles left are the term miles less the difference between the coverage's expiration odometer and the unit's odometer at delivery on its agreement, never below 0.
- The term months, term miles and retail plan price are those of the Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit.

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan of 1,200.00, 40 months, 80,000 miles)
The coverage expires 10 whole months after the pricing date at a coverage odometer of 30,000, and the unit was delivered at 2,000.
- Months share: 40 less 10 is 30, over 40, which is 0.75.
- Miles share: 80,000 less 28,000 is 52,000, over 80,000, which is 0.65.

| Coverage | Basis price |
|---|---|
| With that mileage limit | The greater share, 0.75, so 1,200.00 times 0.75 is 900.00 |
| Same expiry date, no mileage limit | 1,200.00 times 0.75 is 900.00 |
| No active coverage | 1,200.00 |

If the coverage instead expired 45 whole months after the pricing date, the months left would be 0 (never below 0). With a mileage limit, the miles share alone would carry the basis price.
